name: availability-chaser

harness.role: Find players with no call for the next fixture, post one notice naming them for the staff, and push the silent players who have an account, once per fixture.
constraints: uk english, no em dashes, no emoji
NEVER chase Belstone - real club, public data only, availability we do not have
never write a call on a player's behalf; absence of a call is the finding
one notice per fixture, never a second
harness.done_when: one notifications row of kind 'call' exists for the next fixture, or every player has called in

comms.actuation: notifications table, kind=call, read in the app by manager and coach; plus one web push per fixture to silent players with a linked account (push_subscriptions, 0013)
comms.note: no email. players have no email column and inventing an address is worse than not sending. the push goes only to a device the player turned on themselves

scope: supabase://ghkazaxuznltpxfzvxny/clubs (real clubs: is_demo=false; plus demo_writable=true. never a public-data club like Belstone)

capabilities.db_write: notifications insert; push_subscriptions delete (dead endpoints only)

permissions.note: route refuses without CRON_SECRET. service role since 30 Sep 2026 (real clubs are private to anon), so the code is the scope: the club filter above, every read and write keyed to that club id

tenancy.note: every real club and every club open to try, each on its own rows; a public-data club (is_demo and not demo_writable) is never chased. pushes only reach that club's own members' devices

audit.note: the notice body IS the retained input - the names that were silent at run time, kept beside the action they caused

actions.idempotency_key: chase:{fixture_id} (one kind=call notice per fixture; the push rides on that notice, so a rerun pushes nobody)
